description: The view from inside an orange tent at dawn. The viewer's hands in mustard sleeves pull the tent door open. Just outside, only a step away, a red fox stands on the grass, sniffs at the tent and the hand holding the door, then lifts its head and looks around. Behind it lie hiking boots, a black kettle and a metal mug on a flat rock, and a canoe on the grass. Tall pine trees stand beside a misty lake, with mountains under a pale pink sky.
